name: aMule Nuxt
description: Control an aMule daemon: downloads, uploads, shared files, servers, search, Kad and preferences.
instructions: Use amule-status first to check whether the daemon and the networks are connected. Downloads are identified by their 32 hex character file hash, which amule-downloads returns. amule-download-remove and amule-server-remove are destructive: confirm with the user before calling them. Start a search with amule-search, then poll amule-search-results - results keep arriving for a few seconds. For keywords worth watching over hours or days, create an automatic search with amule-auto-search-start; the server re-runs it every few minutes and amule-auto-searches reads what it has accumulated. amule-auto-search-control with action delete discards the accumulated results: confirm with the user before calling it.

tools.name: amule-auto-search-control
tools.title: Amule Auto Search Control
tools.description: Stop, resume or delete an automatic search by id (see amule-auto-searches). Stopping keeps the accumulated results; deleting discards them, so confirm deletions with the user. Resuming restarts the clock: the search gets its full duration again from now.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the automatic search

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: What to do with it

tools.name: amule-auto-searches
tools.title: Amule Auto Searches
tools.description: List the automatic searches the server keeps re-running, or read one by id including its accumulated results. Results are deduplicated by file hash across passes; each carries the eD2k link amule-download-add accepts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Read this search with its results; omit for the overview of all searches

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return for one search, sorted by source count (default 25)

tools.name: amule-auto-search-start
tools.title: Amule Auto Search Start
tools.description: Create an automatic search the server re-runs every few minutes for the chosen time span (or until stopped), cycling the chosen networks and accumulating results deduplicated by file hash. Useful for finding files on machines that are not online right now. Follow up with amule-auto-searches.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keywords

parameters.name: networks
parameters.description: Networks cycled pass by pass (default Kad and Global)

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long to keep re-running: an hour, a day, a week, a month, or forever until stopped (default 1d)

tools.name: amule-download-add
tools.title: Amule Download Add
tools.description: Add one or more downloads to aMule from ed2k:// or magnet: links. Each link is reported as added, duplicate (already queued or already shared, so aMule only merged sources) or rejected with the reason.

parameters.name: links
parameters.description: ed2k:// or magnet: links to add. An entry holding several links is split, so a pasted batch works as one entry too

tools.name: amule-download-control
tools.title: Amule Download Control
tools.description: Pause, resume or change the priority of an aMule download, addressed by its file hash (see amule-downloads).

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: 32 hex character file hash of the download

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: What to do with the download

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Required when action is 'priority'

tools.name: amule-download-remove
tools.title: Amule Download Remove
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: remove a download from the aMule queue. aMule deletes the data downloaded so far. Confirm with the user before calling this.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: 32 hex character file hash of the download to remove

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true to acknowledge that partial data is deleted

tools.name: amule-downloads
tools.title: Amule Downloads
tools.description: List the aMule download queue. Each entry includes the 32 hex character file hash needed by the other download tools, plus size, progress, speed, sources and status.

tools.name: amule-logs
tools.title: Amule Logs
tools.description: Read the aMule daemon log. Useful to find out why an action failed, because aMule logs the detailed reason there while the External Connection only returns a short message.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: How many of the most recent lines to return (default 50)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only return lines containing this text

tools.name: amule-network
tools.title: Amule Network
tools.description: Connect or disconnect the aMule networks, or control Kad: start, stop, bootstrap from a known node, or reload nodes.dat from a URL.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: What to do

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Limits connect / disconnect to one network

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Node IP for kad-bootstrap

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Node port for kad-bootstrap

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: nodes.dat URL for kad-update-nodes

tools.name: amule-preferences
tools.title: Amule Preferences
tools.description: Read or change aMule preferences: nickname, bandwidth limits (KB/s, 0 = unlimited) and connection limits. Call with no arguments to read the current values; any argument given is applied and the resulting preferences are returned.

parameters.name: nickname
parameters.description: New client nickname

parameters.name: maxUpload
parameters.description: Upload limit in KB/s, 0 = unlimited

parameters.name: maxDownload
parameters.description: Download limit in KB/s, 0 = unlimited

parameters.name: maxConnections
parameters.description: Maximum number of connections

parameters.name: maxSourcesPerFile
parameters.description: Maximum sources per file

tools.name: amule-search
tools.title: Amule Search
tools.description: Start a file search on the Kad or eD2k network, or on the connected server. Results keep arriving for a few seconds, so poll amule-search-results afterwards.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keywords

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Network to search (default Kad)

tools.name: amule-search-download
tools.title: Amule Search Download
tools.description: Queue a file from the current aMule search results for download, addressed by its file hash (see amule-search-results).

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: 32 hex character file hash of the search result

tools.name: amule-search-results
tools.title: Amule Search Results
tools.description: Return the results collected so far for the running (or last) aMule search, sorted by source count. Each result carries the file hash needed by amule-search-download.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results (default 25)

tools.name: amule-server-control
tools.title: Amule Server Control
tools.description: Manage the eD2k server list: connect to a server, add one, remove one (destructive, confirm first), or reload the list from a server.met URL. Servers are addressed as ip:port.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: What to do

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Server address as ip:port (required for connect, add and remove)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Display name when adding a server

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: server.met URL for update-list (defaults to the configured one)

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Must be true for remove

tools.name: amule-servers
tools.title: Amule Servers
tools.description: List the eD2k servers aMule knows, with address, users, files, ping, priority and failed connection count.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of servers to return (default 25)

tools.name: amule-shared-files
tools.title: Amule Shared Files
tools.description: List the files aMule shares, with size, requests, accepted requests, bytes uploaded, share ratio, queued clients and the ed2k link.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only return files whose name contains this text

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 50)

tools.name: amule-statistics
tools.title: Amule Statistics
tools.description: Get aMule transfer statistics: totals, current rates, limits, queued clients, shared file count and eD2k/Kad network size. Pass tree=true for the full statistics tree aMule maintains.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: Return the full statistics tree instead of the summary

tools.name: amule-status
tools.title: Amule Status
tools.description: Get the aMule daemon status: External Connection state, ed2k and Kad connection state, connected server, client ID and current transfer speeds.

tools.name: amule-uploads
tools.title: Amule Uploads
tools.description: List the clients aMule is currently uploading to, including the file, remote user, address, client software, speed, session and all-time bytes and queue position.
